summary.text: Rick Bennett is an independent candidate for governor and a state senator who left the Republican Party in 2025. He previously served in the Maine House (1990–1994) and Senate (1996–2004), was Senate President in 2001–2002, and chaired the Maine Republican Party from 2013 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Elected to the Maine House in 1990; was the Republican nominee for Maine's 2nd Congressional District in 1994 and lost the 2012 Republican U.S. Senate primary.
Served in the Maine Senate from 1996 until term limits in 2004, becoming Senate President in 2001; returned to the Senate in 2020 and has served since.
Chaired the successful ballot initiative banning foreign governments from spending in Maine elections, according to his campaign.
